contact.mapQuery: AnShu Asian Cafe, 122 Coach Light Way, Aiken, SC 29803

hero.title: Fresh from *the wok*
hero.lede: Fresh, flavorful Asian cooking for dine-in and takeout: Pad Thai and Singapore curry noodles, honey walnut shrimp, ginger salmon and grilled kabobs. Spice made to your taste, and gluten-free on request.

image.alt: Pan-fried dumplings on a bed of shredded cabbage

sections.title: The *menu*
sections.intro: Prices are lunch / dinner. Tell us how spicy you like it, if you need a dish gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan, and about any allergies.

sections.title: Feed *the whole crew*

image.alt: Pan-fried dumplings on a bed of shredded cabbage

body: AnShu caters private parties and gatherings, and delivers catering orders for ten or more guests. Call for catering details and availability.
For takeout, call (803) 226-0556 to place your order.

items.a: Monday to Saturday, 11:30 am to 2:30 pm and 4 to 9 pm. We’re closed on Sundays.

items.q: Can you make a dish gluten-free?
items.a: Many dishes can be made gluten-free on request. Tell us when you order, along with any allergies.
Yes: private parties and catering, with delivery for ten or more guests.
